# Harness concepts

What each harness reads, emits and does on its own, as its concepts declare. `npm run harness:self-report -- <harness>` searches the installed build for every declared instruction file and hook event, and where the harness lists its own skills or MCP servers without an account, runs that listing against a throwaway home holding a probe in each declared place. Cursor's SDK reports what its local agent loaded when its service asks, so its listing runs that agent against a stand-in service that takes any key: no account and no model request. `scripts/test-harness-concepts.ts` fails when a fixture lacks a name, a listing misses a place, or Mako reads or writes somewhere the harness doesn't.

| Harness | Checked on | Version | Places confirmed by |

| Claude Code | 2026-10-06 | 2.1.290 | its own listing (MCP) |
| Codex | 2026-10-06 | 0.159.3 | its own listing (skills) |
| Cursor | 2026-10-06 | SDK 1.0.31 | its own listing (skills, MCP) |
| OpenCode | 2026-10-12 | 2.0.27 | its own listing (skills, MCP) |
| Grok | 2026-10-06 | 1.0.46 | its own listing (skills, MCP) |
| Devin | 2026-10-06 | 3000.10.23 | its own listing (skills, MCP) |

## Instructions

- **Claude Code**: `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/AGENTS.md`; rules `.claude/rules`; for every project `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/rules`. Managed policy, then the user's, then every directory from the filesystem root down to the working directory, concatenated, CLAUDE.local.md after CLAUDE.md; a subdirectory's files load when a tool touches it. AGENTS.md is read only where no CLAUDE.md exists (instructionFiles claude-md-or-agents-md). @path imports, four hops deep.
- **Codex**: `AGENTS.override.md`, `AGENTS.md`; rules none; for every project `~/.codex/AGENTS.override.md`, `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`. The global file, then one file per directory from the project root down to the working directory (override first, then AGENTS.md, then project_doc_fallback_filenames), joined root first and capped at project_doc_max_bytes, 32 KiB.
- **Cursor**: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `.cursorrules`; rules `.cursor/rules`; for every project none. With settingSources project: each workspace root and its ancestors, nested rules included; each file is always applied. A .cursor/rules/*.mdc applies always, by globs, by description or manually, from its frontmatter. User Rules aren't on disk.
- **OpenCode**: `AGENTS.md`; rules none; for every project `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md`. The global file, then every AGENTS.md from the working directory up to the project directory; watched. No CLAUDE.md fallback in 2.x.
- **Grok**: `Agents.md`, `Claude.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `AGENT.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`; rules `.grok/rules`, `.claude/rules`, `.cursor/rules`; for every project `~/.grok/rules`, `~/.claude/rules`, `~/.cursor/rules`. Home first (Grok, Claude, Cursor), then the repo root down to the working directory, every match loaded and deeper ones winning; project files need folder trust.
- **Devin**: `AGENTS.md`, `agents.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `AGENT.md`, `.windsurfrules`, `CLAUDE.md`; rules `.devin/rules`, `.windsurf/rules`, `.cursor/rules`; for every project `~/.config/devin/AGENTS.md`, `~/.devin/rules`, `~/.devin/global_rules.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`. The workspace root down to the working directory, a subdirectory's files when the agent touches it; .devin/global_rules.md over .windsurf's; each always-on rule capped at 32 KiB. read_config_from turns off each other tool's files.

## Hooks

- **Claude Code**: configured in `~/.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/settings.local.json`. 33 events: `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `PostToolBatch`, `Notification`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `UserPromptExpansion`, `SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`, `Stop`, `StopFailure`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`, `PreCompact`, `PostCompact`, `PreModelSwitch`, `PostModelSwitch`, `PermissionRequest`, `PermissionDenied`, `Setup`, `TeammateIdle`, `TaskCreated`, `TaskCompleted`, `Elicitation`, `ElicitationResult`, `ConfigChange`, `WorktreeCreate`, `WorktreeRemove`, `InstructionsLoaded`, `CwdChanged`, `FileChanged`, `DirectoryAdded`, `MessageDisplay`. Exit 2 blocks with stderr as the reason; exit 0 stdout JSON: continue, decision, hookSpecificOutput (PreToolUse permissionDecision allow|deny|ask|defer, updatedInput). Handlers: command, prompt, agent, http, mcp_tool. Also from plugin hooks/hooks.json and skill or agent frontmatter.
- **Codex**: configured in `~/.codex/hooks.json`, `~/.codex/config.toml`, `.codex/hooks.json`, `.codex/config.toml`. 12 events: `PreToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`, `PostToolUse`, `PreCompact`, `PostCompact`, `SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`, `Stop`, `Interrupt`. Layers merge; project hooks load once the project is trusted, and non-managed hooks need trust by hash (/hooks). Exit 2 or permissionDecision deny blocks a tool; decision block on Stop continues the turn. Handlers: command, mcp_tool. The app-server reports runs as hook/started and hook/completed.
- **Cursor**: configured in `~/.cursor/hooks.json`, `.cursor/hooks.json`, `~/.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/settings.local.json`. 21 events: `beforeShellExecution`, `beforeMCPExecution`, `afterShellExecution`, `afterMCPExecution`, `beforeReadFile`, `afterFileEdit`, `beforeTabFileRead`, `afterTabFileEdit`, `stop`, `beforeSubmitPrompt`, `afterAgentResponse`, `afterAgentThought`, `sessionStart`, `sessionEnd`, `preCompact`, `subagentStart`, `subagentStop`, `preToolUse`, `postToolUse`, `postToolUseFailure`, `workspaceOpen`. { version: 1, hooks } per source; Claude settings map onto these names. permission allow|deny|ask, deny over ask over allow; exit 2 denies, other failures pass unless failClosed. In the SDK a denied shell call throws.
- **OpenCode**: configured in `~/.config/opencode/plugins`, `~/.config/opencode/plugin`, `.opencode/plugins`, `.opencode/plugin`. 13 events (names built at run time): `tool.execute.before`, `tool.execute.after`, `session.prompt`, `session.title`, `session.context`, `session.compaction`, `session.generate`, `session.model.request`, `session.http.request`, `session.http.response`, `session.retry`, `permission.evaluate`, `shell.create.before`. Plugins, not shell hooks: a module exporting { id, effect | setup } that mutates the payload of tool execute.before/after, session prompt…retry, permission evaluate and shell create.before. Also the plugins config key.
- **Grok**: configured in `~/.grok/hooks`, `.grok/hooks`, `~/.grok/config.toml`, `~/.grok/disabled-hooks`, `~/.claude/settings.json`, `~/.claude/settings.local.json`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/settings.local.json`, `~/.cursor/hooks.json`, `.cursor/hooks.json`. 15 events: `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `PermissionDenied`, `Stop`, `StopFailure`, `StopCancelled`, `Notification`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`, `PreCompact`, `PostCompact`, `SessionEnd`. UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse and Stop block: decision allow|deny|ask|defer, exit 2 denies, other failures pass. Claude tool names map to Grok's in matchers. An ACP client registers its own through _x.ai/hooks.
- **Devin**: configured in `.devin/hooks.v1.json`, `.devin/config.json`, `.devin/config.local.json`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/settings.local.json`, `~/.config/devin/config.json`, `~/.claude.json`, `~/.claude/settings.json`, `~/.claude/settings.local.json`. 8 events: `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `Stop`, `PostCompaction`, `SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`. Exit 2 blocks; stdout decision approve|block, hookSpecificOutput additionalContext and updatedInput; a blocking Stop makes the agent continue. Handlers: command, prompt.

## Commands

- **Claude Code**: `~/.claude/commands`, `.claude/commands`. Merged into skills; command files still load, `dir/name.md` as /dir:name.
- **Codex**: none. 0.159 reads no prompt files: ~/.codex/prompts is retired and the binary has no /prompts: route; commands are skills, and a Claude or Cursor command is imported as a source-command-<name> skill.
- **Cursor**: none. The SDK loads no command folder; Cursor moved commands into skills (disable-model-invocation).
- **OpenCode**: `~/.config/opencode/commands`, `~/.config/opencode/command`, `.opencode/commands`, `.opencode/command`. Also the commands config key; $1…$N, $ARGUMENTS and !`cmd`.
- **Grok**: `.grok/commands`, `.agents/commands`, `.claude/commands`, `.cursor/commands`, `~/.grok/commands`, `~/.agents/commands`, `~/.claude/commands`, `~/.cursor/commands`
- **Devin**: none. Skills are its slash commands. 3000.10.23 imported no .claude/commands file, though its docs say it does, and reads no .devin/commands.

## Output

- **Claude Code**: live: Agent SDK over stream-json, with control requests; one-shot: `text`, `json`, `stream-json`
- **Codex**: live: app-server JSON-RPC over stdio; one-shot: `exec --json`
- **Cursor**: live: @cursor/sdk run stream and deltas, in a Mako-owned child; one-shot: `text`, `json`, `stream-json`
- **OpenCode**: live: opencode serve HTTP API under /api with SSE /api/event, through @opencode/client; one-shot: `run --format json`
- **Grok**: live: ACP over stdio, with _x.ai extensions; one-shot: `plain`, `json`, `streaming-json`, `streaming-messages-json`
- **Devin**: live: ACP over stdio, with cognition.ai extensions; one-shot: `print (plain text)`, `export (ATIF)`

## Session records

- **Claude Code**: ~/.claude/projects/<working directory, non-alphanumerics as ->/<session>.jsonl, with <session>/subagents/; resuming appends to the same file. Encodings: `plain`. branches: parentUuid, with an explicit last-prompt's leafUuid after a rewind naming the message the conversation continues from (the nil id clears it); copies: forkedFrom.sessionId on /branch, --fork-session and a background continuation, whose source then names it in continued-in. Checked against 2.1.296 on 2026-10-13.
- **Codex**: ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-<time>-<thread>[_<rollout>].jsonl, flattened into ~/.codex/archived_sessions when archived, compressed in place after a week untouched and restored on resume; named in ~/.codex/session_index.jsonl and state_5.sqlite. Encodings: `plain`, `zstd`. continues: session_meta.history_base: a revert's new rollout, or a fork, continues the rollout it names up to end_byte_offset; rewinds: event_msg thread_rolled_back: the latest turns, whole; copies: session_meta.forked_from_id on a fork that copied its source's rollout. Checked against 0.159.3 on 2026-10-13.
- **Cursor**: SQLite index.db and agents/<agent>/store.db under the SDK state root (Mako's: ~/.mako/cursor-sdk); cursor-agent keeps ~/.cursor/chats/<hash>/<id>/store.db, content-addressed blobs and a meta row. Encodings: `plain`. branches: meta.latestRootBlobId (an SDK agent's in index.db's agents.latest_checkpoint_ref_json): the root blob whose turns are the conversation; older roots are earlier states, each run's last in runs.latest_checkpoint_ref_json. A fork is a new agent indexed at one of them in a clone of its source's store; nothing in it names the source. Checked against cursor-agent 2026.10.01 on 2026-10-13.
- **OpenCode**: ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db (SQLite: session_v2 and session_message; a store migrated from v1 keeps session, message and part beside them). Encodings: `plain`. holds-undo: session_v2.revert (session.revert in v1): messages from its messageID on, from its partID on in v1, until the next prompt commits it; copies: session_v2.fork_session_id; a v1 fork only by its "(fork #n)" title; generations: session (v1) beside session_v2: OpenCode 2 writes only session_v2. Checked against 2.0.27 on 2026-10-13.
- **Grok**: ~/.grok/sessions/<encoded working directory>/<id>/updates.jsonl, one ACP update per line, with summary.json and plan.md. Encodings: `plain`. rewinds: rewind_marker: back to before its target-th counted turn; copies: summary.json parent_session_id and forked_at. Checked against 1.0.46 on 2026-10-13.
- **Devin**: ~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db (SQLite: sessions, messages, message_nodes, tool_call_state). Encodings: `plain`. branches: sessions.main_chain_id: the node the conversation ends at, by parent_node_id; a node past it is a call cut off before its result, which Devin resumes without; continues: a compaction's summary row's summarized_from: the node the earlier chain ends at. Checked against 3000.10.23 on 2026-10-13.

## Shared features

One name in Mako for what the harnesses call differently, from each definition's `features`. Bold is the harness's own, shown in Mako; "Mako's" is Mako's own running for every harness, with the harness's own form in parentheses; "none here" means nothing Mako can drive, with the nearest thing the harness has.

| Feature | Claude Code | Codex | Cursor | OpenCode | Grok | Devin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Goals | **/goal** | **/goal** | Mako's (its own: goals) | Mako's | **/goal** | Mako's |
| Code review | **/code-review, /security-review, /ultrareview** | **/review** | Mako's | **/review** | Mako's | Mako's (its own: /loop) |
| Side questions | **/btw** | **/side, /btw** | Mako's | **session.generate** | **/btw** | **/btw** |
| Scheduled prompts | /loop: Mako gap | none | none | none | /loop: Mako gap | none |
| Cloud runs | --cloud, /schedule: Mako gap | codex cloud: Mako gap | cloud agents: Mako gap | none | none | /handoff: Mako gap |
| Background sessions | Mako's (its own: claude --bg) | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's |
| File rewind | Mako's (its own: /rewind) | Mako's (its own: thread/revert) | Mako's | Mako's (its own: /undo, /redo) | Mako's (its own: /rewind) | Mako's (its own: /revert) |
| Worktrees | Mako's (its own: --worktree) | Mako's (its own: /worktree) | Mako's | Mako's (its own: worktrees) | Mako's (its own: -w) | Mako's |
| Computer use | Mako's (its own: computer use) | Mako's (its own: computer use) | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's |
| Notifications | Mako's (its own: PushNotification) | Mako's (its own: notify) | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's |
| Folder trust | trust dialog: Mako gap | trust_level: Mako gap | none | **external_directory** | **folder trust** | workspace trust: Mako gap |
| Edit before approving | updatedInput: Mako gap | none | none | none | none | editable commands: Mako gap |
| Plugins | plugins, by default | plugins, by default | plugins: Mako gap | plugins, by default | plugins, by default | plugins, by default |
| Response style | output styles, by default | none here (personality) | none | none | none here (/personas) | none |
| Web search | **WebSearch** | **web_search, web__run** | none here (webSearch) | **websearch** | **web_search** | **web_search** |
| Image generation | none | **image generation** | **generateImage** | none | **image_gen, image_edit** | none |
| Code mode | none | **exec** | none | **execute** | none | none |

## Only this harness

From each harness definition's `unique`: what carries it natively, and where Mako shows it, or why it doesn't.

| Harness | Feature | Native | In Mako |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cursor | Screen recording | the `recordScreen` tool: start, save or discard a recording of the screen | tool rows: `recordScreen` |
| Grok | X search | `x_search`, a server-side xAI search of X, reported by its title | tool rows: `x_search` |
| Grok | Video generation | the `image_to_video` and `reference_to_video` tools; `/imagine-video` | tool rows: `image_to_video`, `reference_to_video` |
| Grok | Announcements | `_x.ai/announcements/update` | nothing to show: They're xAI's product news for Grok's own pager, so Mako ignores them. |

## Tool definitions

Each harness's tools as it defines them, recorded per version by `npm run harness:native-tools -- <harness>` into `scripts/fixtures/native-tools`. `scripts/test-native-tools.ts` fails when the newest defines a tool the vocabulary doesn't declare, when a declared tool is neither defined nor `unlisted` with a reason, or when a declared argument key isn't a parameter. `--diff <harness> <a> <b>` names what changed between two versions.

| Harness | Version | Recorded | Tools | Configurations | Declared, unlisted | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code | 2.1.283 | 2026-10-06 | 27 (15 deferred) | 6 | 16 | the tools in the model request of Claude Code as Mako's SDK driver launches it (claudeSdkOptions), once per Mako mode; deferred tools' schemas from a second run with tool search off |
| Codex | 0.159.3 | 2026-10-06 | 22 (9 called from a script) | 16 | 16 | the tools in the model request of Codex's app-server with Mako's thread config (codexInteractiveConfig, codexCollaborationMode), per listed model, with and without plan |
| Cursor | 1.0.31 | 2026-10-06 | 16 | 1 | 8 | the tool-call schema in @cursor/sdk (ConversationStepSchema's toolCall message): the arguments Cursor reports each tool with, not its model's definitions |
| OpenCode | 2.0.27 | 2026-10-12 | 13 | 4 | 3 | the tools in the model request of OpenCode's native API as Mako starts it (startOpenCodeApi), per agent Mako's modes use, on an Anthropic and an OpenAI model |
| Grok | 1.0.46 | 2026-10-08 | 26 | 4 | 2 | the tools in the model request of grok agent stdio as Mako's ACP source launches it, once per Mako mode |
| Devin | 3000.10.23 | 2026-10-08 | 24 | 4 | 3 | the tools in Devin's GetChatMessage request to a stand-in Windsurf API, devin acp launched as Mako's ACP source launches it, once per Mako mode; not smart, which Devin offers only to an account whose settings allow it |
